Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: In Step 11, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the foundation behind the Free Software Directory was the Free Software Foundation Europe (FSFE) and started by Georg Greve. This is factually incorrect; the Free Software Directory is explicitly stated on its own page (accessed in Step 10) as a project of the Free Software Foundation (FSF), which was founded by Richard Stallman. The Planner hallucinated a different foundation (FSFE) and founder (Georg Greve) without any supporting evidence from the conversation, contradicting the clear confirmation obtained in Step 10 that the Directory belongs to the FSF.
